plain_summary: This page introduces Vessel Traffic Services (VTS) charges, explaining they are for safe navigation, pollution, and conservancy, based on a vessel's gross tonnage (GT). It specifies how GT is determined for tariff purposes, referencing the Tonnage Convention 1969. It then lists the VTS charges per GT per port call, differentiating rates for Durban and Saldanha Bay versus other ports, and states a minimum fee. Finally, it provides a list of exemptions from VTS charges.

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: VTS charge per port call at all ports excluding Durban and Saldanha Bay
VTS charge per port call at the ports of Durban and Saldanha Bay
Tonnage Convention year for GT determination
